# Shared C/Rust nft rule vector. The table names are namespaced per controller.
firewall=nft
source_port=31337
destination=198.51.100.7
destination_port=443
timeout_seconds=300
rust_add_args=add|element|inet|r2o_rst|rst4|{ 31337 . 198.51.100.7 . 443 timeout 300s }
rust_delete_args=delete|element|inet|r2o_rst|rst4|{ 31337 . 198.51.100.7 . 443 }
c_add=nft add element inet d2k_rst rst4 { 31337 . 198.51.100.7 . 443 timeout 300s }
c_delete=nft delete element inet d2k_rst rst4 { 31337 . 198.51.100.7 . 443 }
